gateQuestion: Why did the frozen v2 baseline move from 121 to 119?
cause: checkRegressionEvidenceAuthority resolved the declared test block by re-parsing it out of testEvidenceId, while the validator resolves it from evidence.file / evidence.testName. Those disagree when a record id carries a suffix, so the authority checked a different block than the validator.
fix: The authority now uses the same block identity as the validator, falling back to id-parsing only when file/testName are absent. C2R15_BASELINE_OLD_AUTHORITY=1 restores the legacy id-only parse.
